Package io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.services.localization

This package contains everything related to translations and localization.

See: Description

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    ItemTextResolver
    A per-viewer name/lore provider for items whose display is generated at runtime and therefore cannot live in a static items.yml entry - tiered variants with per-tier colours (Supreme mob-tech), items named from data not present in their id (GeneticChickengineering chicken icons), or items whose name depends on the individual stack's PDC (SlimeTinker assembled tools).
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    EnchantDisplay
    Renders an item's enchantments as lore lines placed with the composed blocks (under the Type category) instead of the vanilla client's default position above the lore.
    EnchantTranslationService
    Per-language enchantment display names, read on the Netty thread by EnchantDisplay via EnchantTranslationService.name(java.lang.String, java.lang.String).
    FallbackSafe
    Item ids and message keys that are deliberately shown in English in every language - proper nouns, brand names, universal terms (e.g.
    GuideBookDisplay
    Per-language, immutable-after-boot renderings of the Slimefun Guide book (normal + cheat).
    ItemTextBlocks
    What an ItemTextResolver contributes for one item: an optional display name plus the same ordered lore blocks an items.yml entry authors.
    ItemTranslationService
    Translates Slimefun item names and lore per language.
    ItemTranslationService.ItemTranslation
    A single item's translated name and lore.
    ItemTranslationService.RenderedDisplay
    A rendered per-viewer display: translated name + composed block lore.
    Language
    This Class represents a Language that Slimefun can recognize and use.
    LanguageResolver
    Pure resolution logic for the effective packet-translation language id.
    LoreComposer
    Composes an item's lore from ordered blocks: Type -> Description -> Stats -> Usage, each separated by a single blank line, empty blocks omitted.
    MenuTranslationService
    Translates the decorative info items inside a block's BlockMenu (titles, descriptions and background labels) per language.
    PacketTranslationService
    Rewrites outbound inventory packets so each player sees Slimefun items in their own language, without mutating the stored item.
    RenamedItems
    Marks a SlimefunItem ItemStack as having been given a custom name by a player (via an anvil rename).
    SlimefunLocalization
    This is an abstract parent class of LocalizationService.
    TranslationConfig
    Reads the translation.* config that governs packet-based item translation.
    TranslationCoverageService
    Combines item-unit coverage (leaf name/type/description/stats/usage units, see ItemTranslationService.getItemUnitCoverage(java.lang.String)) and message-unit coverage (message/menu/enchant keys, see LocalizationService.getMessageUnitCoverage(java.lang.String)) into one honest, weighted 0-100 translation-completeness percentage per language.
  • Enum Summary 
    Enum Description
    LanguageFile
    This enum holds the different types of files each Language holds.
    LanguagePreset
    This enum holds info about a Language that is embedded in our resources folder.
    TextDirection
    A simple enum to define the direction of text for a given LanguagePreset
